title: We made dodgeball with eggs
author: rectangle_so
selftext:
Take a break from building. Bench your friends instead 🫪

We just launched Dodge Yolk on EggVerse: its the classic game of dodgeball where you throws yolk balls at your opponents, dodge incoming ball, and catch one to send the thrower packing. 

Sunny side got smacked. Sous purr thought it could do better then smacked. The Eggbot 3000 had absolutely no idea whats going on. 

You can play solo against computers or challenge some friends 2-8.   
  
We’re calling it friendship building. Your friends may disagree.

Free to play at [eggverse.co](http://eggverse.co)

I got a few dms the last time i posted a video like this, honestly here is my workflow. I've been asking ChatGPT to use HeyGen Hyperframe. It takes my sprites and then with a little bit of back and forth on the direction of the video, it pulls everything together. 

it animates the sprites for you & also attempts the play for gameplay footage. You'll notice its a little delayed but honestly its prettttttty good. Has anyone else tried making animated launch videos? how do you use chat to make clips for you? that is what i'm trying to learn next
